plugins.name: GOG Metadata
plugins.shortDescription: Fetches game metadata and artwork from GOG.com, combining the GOG Catalog and GamesDb (Dreamlist) APIs.
plugins.description:
Searches both the GOG Catalog API (games sold on GOG) and the GOG GamesDb/Dreamlist API (delisted and non-GOG games) and merges the results into one list (up to 10 results).

Retrieves title, description, release date, developers, publishers, genres, themes, features (e.g. singleplayer, controller support), user ratings, platforms (Windows, Linux, macOS), covers, headers and screenshots. Requests are cached and rate limited (4 requests per second).

If you want up to 20 results, install the *GOG Metadata (Catalog)* and *GOG Metadata (Dreamlist)* plugins instead.

**Do not install this variant together with the other GOG Metadata variants**, except *Catalog* + *Dreamlist*, or you will get duplicate search results.

plugins.name: GOG Metadata (Catalog)
plugins.shortDescription: Fetches game metadata and artwork from GOG.com, using only the GOG Catalog API.
plugins.description:
Searches only the GOG Catalog API. Gives clean, high-quality results for games that are actively sold on GOG; use other metadata providers for non-GOG or delisted games.

Retrieves title, description, release date, developers, publishers, genres, themes, features (e.g. singleplayer, controller support), user ratings, platforms (Windows, Linux, macOS), covers, headers and screenshots. Requests are cached and rate limited (4 requests per second).

Combine it with *GOG Metadata (Dreamlist)* for up to 20 results.

**Do not install this variant together with the other GOG Metadata variants**, except *Catalog* + *Dreamlist*, or you will get duplicate search results.

plugins.name: GOG Metadata (Dreamlist)
plugins.shortDescription: Fetches game metadata and artwork from GOG.com, using only the GOG GamesDb (Dreamlist) API.
plugins.description:
Searches only the GOG GamesDb/Dreamlist API. Good for delisted, obscure or non-GOG games, but results can be noisy (duplicates or less accurate matches).

Retrieves title, description, release date, developers, publishers, genres, themes, features (e.g. singleplayer, controller support), user ratings, platforms (Windows, Linux, macOS), covers, headers and screenshots. Requests are cached and rate limited (4 requests per second).

Combine it with *GOG Metadata (Catalog)* for up to 20 results.

**Do not install this variant together with the other GOG Metadata variants**, except *Catalog* + *Dreamlist*, or you will get duplicate search results.

plugins.name: PCGamingWiki Metadata
plugins.description: Searches PCGamingWiki for game metadata, including descriptions, developers, publishers, release dates, and supported platforms. Intended as a supplementary provider alongside a primary metadata source.
